name: Bothive Chatbot
description: Chatbot integration for Drupal using bothive.be
project_description: The Bothive Chatbot module embeds the third-party chatbot widget from https://bothive.be into a Drupal site and lets an administrator configure it. It loads the external widget script (https://widget.bothive.be) and initialises it with an API key, obtained from the Bothive dashboard. A valid API key and a Bothive account with the site's domain whitelisted are required for the widget to appear. The module adds an admin configuration form (Administration » Configuration » System » Bothive) where you set the API key, toggle browser-console logging, load the bot in a hidden state (to open it later with your own JavaScript), and restrict the pages it appears on using the Drupal core request_path visibility condition. This module is not developed nor maintained by Bothive itself; it is a community integration by Bram Driesen, sponsored by Tobania.
